titulo: One text with all of it in there
caption:
One text with all of it in there

My friend used to send five texts in a row. Then she started sending one, with all of it in there.

One complete message gets one answer, and it spares the other person five buzzes while they are in the middle of something.

For whoever sends the whole thing in one message.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A bedroom with a small phone standing on the right. A ink-black block figure with white eyes on the left trembles slightly while five tiny bubbles pop up one under the other, hey, so, also, wait, and. They all disappear at once. The figure leans in thinking, its eyes go wide and one bubble says Friday, six, my place. Its eyes turn happy with a pulse. The text stays: me sending it all in one message.
